sayAfter: You hold still behind cover. After a while, the sounds fade. It lost your trail.
🌱 Kalkidan looks over the garden: turned soil, nothing planted. Someone has to sow first.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.

anchoredLines.line: 🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 3 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Mei Petrov. From Thornfield." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."

🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 3 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Oscar Hassan. From Emberhold." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
🌪️ THE HERALD fed in the night — 0 kcal gone from your stores. It is eating the realm while you deliberate.
📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Stonebridge answers! Kira Osei and Yuki Kim will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Thornfield answers! Darius Nakamura and Sam Reyes will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— The Red Table answers! Peter Okafor and Ellis Khan will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)

🛡️ Chris, Divine, Sari step forward. They will march with the muster, eat from your stores (1000 kcal/day each), and stand in front of THE HERALD. They can die — Haven does not get them back, and the fire will be quieter. Tap again — Haven sends its own.
🛡️ Haven commits its own: Chris, Divine, Sari march with the muster. Not loaned. Not asked-for. Ours. The coalition counts 9 blades against THE HERALD — it needs 10.
